title: The Flight Home
summary: Xiao Li brings the Black-Corner sect leaders who have agreed to fight the Misty Cloud Sect, and Xiao Yan promises them their reward. The group boards a flying ship and leaves the Black-Corner Region for the Jia Ma Empire. In the Misty Cloud Sect's Forbidden Hall, Yun Shan tells Yun Yun he will wipe out the Xiao Clan and the Mite'er family who shelter them. In the capital, Ya Fei warns Hai Bodong and the Mite'er family that the Misty Cloud Sect is planning an attack. A month into the journey, in the small country of Wanyan, Zi Yan and Cai Lin raid the treasure cave of a greedy Dou Zong sect leader. Zi Yan lures away its guard, a Rank Six Magical Beast, while Cai Lin takes the herbs, then Cai Lin frees the beast from its master's seal. Back on the ship Xiao Yan scolds them for the risk and forbids them to leave again.
